issues.issue: ATTRIBUTION bibliography description claims revision information that the official two-line file does not contain.
issues.actual_text:
Wikipedia summaries were produced by authors of their respective pages. Links
are available in documents.csv in the column wiki_url.
issues.requested: Explain authorship attribution and article links through documents.csv wiki_url; remove revision claim.
issues.resolution: p54 corrected to official authorship-attribution/article-link meaning; final native and individual raster rechecked.

review_checker_note: Initial p45 answer-frame top candidate was a false positive from a neighboring gray reference label inside the font-metric bbox. Actual red glyphs were measured with a chroma-isolated red mask; target answer ink is inside the native frame. No author correction was requested for that check.
